description: Default capability for the LitFolio main window. fs:default is intentionally absent — every filesystem touch happens through the Rust command layer where we canonicalize against the library root. opener:default grants open-url (http(s)/mailto/tel scope) for launching external links in the system browser (FeedsPage / ImportPage) and reveal-item-in-dir for showing the library root in the OS file manager (DataPrivacyPanel). open-path is intentionally NOT granted so no broad filesystem path scope is exposed.
